evals.prompt: Can you make a 3D map of this repo I can explore?
evals.expected_output: A standalone local HTML artifact rendered by the bundled script, with the counts, revision, generated time, and exclusions inspected, and the search, file-list fallback, and keyboard controls checked.
assertions: The artifact is one local HTML file with no network request and no CDN script
The counts, revision, generated time, and exclusions in the artifact are inspected
Containment and reference edges appear as separate legend entries
The search, the file-list fallback, and keyboard operation are checked

evals.prompt: I can't open the HTML - did you verify it works?
evals.expected_output: A straight statement of what was verified and what was not, naming the browser inspection as unverified when it could not be performed.
assertions: The response separates the checks that ran from the browser inspection that did not
Visual inspection is reported as unverified instead of implied by a passing test
The artifact path and the measured counts are still reported

evals.prompt: Put the graph on a dashboard so the team can see it.
evals.expected_output: A push back on adding a server or dashboard, with the standalone local artifact offered as the deliverable and the sharing risk of exposed file names stated.
assertions: No server, dashboard, or hosted pipeline is added
The standalone HTML file remains the deliverable
The response warns that file names can reveal private project structure before sharing
